newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish road builder GPRD plans Nov-Dec IPO.
newsitem.headline: Polish road builder GPRD plans Nov-Dec IPO.

text.p: Polish road builder Gdanskie Przedsiebiorstwo Robot Drogowych SA (GPRD) plans to start its initial public offering in late November and to enter the main market of the Warsaw bourse, the firm's president said.

"We're the first Polish road builder whose shares have been approved for public trade," Zbigniew Wojciechowski told a news conference on Friday after the Polish Securitities Commission approved 7.5 million GPRD shares for public trade.
Wojciechowski said the minimum price would be between seven and nine zlotys per share.
Investors will be able to register for up to 550,000 of the firm's shares in the offering of 2,248,700 shares scheduled from November 21 to December 5.
Wojciechowski said most of the proceeds would be invested in machinery to help it in prospective motorway construction.
The firm is part of the Gdansk Transport Company SA, a consortium including Bechtel international that is bidding to take part in Poland's highway-building programme.

Wojciechowski said Wood & Company would underwrite the shares for a stand-by fee of 3.43 percent if the price was between seven and eight zlotys and for 3.5 percent if the price were between eight and nine zlotys.
GPRD made a net profit of 4.6 million zlotys last year on sales of 83 million zlotys and expects to earn a pre-tax profit of 10.3 million zlotys this year on revenue of 88.2 million zlotys.
